system.description: You have learned how to marry chemistry and fashion to augment your accessories. You may store an instance of your @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-class-features.Item.f2syblzgm6at7i7q]{Tactical Chemistry} in some form of fashionable accessory. This could be a lapel flower that squirts acid, a walking cane that can become a torch, or an earring that can be deployed as a smoke bomb. While this chemical creation is more stable than normal instances of Tactical Chemistry, it must be used in a timely fashion or it dissolves as normal. Any stored instances of Tactical Chemistry that are not used within 24 hours of being created melt into useless goo.
